pins.title: The Watchtower of the Hollow Eye | Brutalist Surrealism
pins.description: A monumental concrete structure takes the form of an abstract human face, with a vast circular eye opening, heavy geometric features and a staircase leading into the unknown. Weathered surfaces and massive brutalist volumes give the building the presence of an ancient watchtower or forgotten guardian. This surreal composition blends brutalist architecture, architectural surrealism, impossible architecture and monumental sculpture with raw concrete textures and dystopian atmosphere. A striking vision of dark surrealism, futuristic ruins, abstract brutalism, dreamlike architecture, colossal monuments and conceptual architectural art.
